title: Attorneys and small law firms
hypothesis: The generic attorney recipe-B route cannot safely produce a contact because it proceeds from firm identity toward private residential tracing. The NY attorney registration is the implemented free public business-contact alternative: its current registration, firm, and published office phone create a business-contact candidate, while surname-in-firm remains owner-probability evidence only.
ownerSource: No generic attorney owner source is safely implemented. For NY, data.ny.gov eqw2-r5nb supplies a currently registered attorney and firm; a surname in the firm name is a heuristic candidate signal, not owner confirmation.
phoneSource: For NY, the public Attorney Registrations dataset supplies the published office phone. It is a business-contact candidate, not evidence of a mobile handset or direct owner phone. The generic recipe-B residence/trace phone path is held.

workflow.label: Attorney request
workflow.detail: Resolve the requested state before selecting a source; Maps cannot be the deliverable for attorney routes.

workflow.label: Public business-contact route available?
workflow.detail: NY has the catalog-verified court registration dataset. The generic attorney route has no safe mapped public business-contact source.

workflow.label: Hold generic private route
workflow.detail: Do not use the generic recipe-B parcel, residential, or trace path, and do not replace it with a Maps deliverable.

workflow.label: NY public attorney registration
workflow.detail: Read the current NY registration, firm, and published office-phone candidate from eqw2-r5nb.

workflow.label: Current person and firm filter
workflow.detail: Keep currently registered people with a firm and normalized published phone; hold inactive, non-person, firmless, or phoneless rows.

workflow.label: Registration hold
workflow.detail: Hold inactive, non-person, missing-firm, missing-phone, or source-unavailable rows.

workflow.label: Business-contact candidate
workflow.detail: Use the public office phone only as a business-contact candidate. Surname-in-firm is a heuristic owner-probability signal.

workflow.label: Phone reuse and switchboard check
workflow.detail: Hold high-reuse or switchboard patterns; uniqueness is not proof of a direct owner handset.

workflow.label: Shared-contact hold
workflow.detail: Hold phone candidates shared across several attorneys or otherwise identified as an office switchboard.

workflow.label: Line and compliance gates
workflow.detail: Require mobile classification, reachability, DNC/TCPA clearance, suppression, duplicate, freshness, and timezone checks.

workflow.label: Contact gate hold
workflow.detail: Hold landline, VoIP, unreachable, DNC/TCPA, suppressed, duplicate, stale, or timezone-unresolved candidates.

workflow.label: Independent owner and direct-contact evidence
workflow.detail: An owner-confirmed result requires current owner/founder evidence for the firm and an explicit direct-business-contact link to this phone.

workflow.label: Owner claim unresolved
workflow.detail: Hold heuristic-only, employee, associate, front-desk, conflicting, or unlinked evidence; do not infer handset ownership.

workflow.label: Future owner-confirmed delivery
workflow.detail: Deliver an owner-confirmed attorney contact only after the business-contact and owner/direct-contact evidence gates pass.

edges.label: current person, firm, and published phone

failures.risk: The generic attorney recipe-B route moves from firm identity toward private residential tracing.
failures.mitigation: Keep it held and require an eligible public business-contact source; do not use parcel, residential, or private-phone enrichment.

failures.risk: Maps is used as the deliverable for attorney or NY-attorney fallback.
failures.mitigation: Keep both keys in NEVER_MAPS_DELIVERABLE and preserve the fallback block.

failures.risk: A surname-in-firm heuristic is treated as owner confirmation.
failures.mitigation: Store it as owner-probability evidence only and require a supported independent owner/direct-contact assessment for an owner label.

failures.risk: A published NY office phone is treated as a personal mobile or direct owner handset.
failures.mitigation: Require reuse, line, reachability, DNC/TCPA, suppression, freshness, timezone, and explicit direct-business-contact evidence separately.

failures.risk: A firm switchboard shared by several attorneys enters a direct-contact path.
failures.mitigation: Apply a source-phone reuse threshold and hold shared-contact patterns before direct-contact classification.

iterations.hypothesis: The NY parser retains only a current person-level registration and labels a firm surname match as a heuristic rather than parsing it as explicit ownership.
iterations.test: Five-case local fixture/code audit on 2026-09-24 using five saved rows from tests/fixtures/registers/ny_attorneys.json and the focused ny_attorneys test. Command: node --experimental-strip-types --test --test-name-pattern='ny_attorneys' tests/lead-engine-registers.test.ts. No network, paid call, secret, private lookup, contact compilation, or phone verification ran.
iterations.observed: The focused test passed. The five audited saved rows were current NY registrations with firm and normalized office-phone fields and were retained as Attorney, not Named Partner. Its paired synthetic surname variation produced Named Partner; its Delinquent variation held as status_not_registered. This measures parser behavior only, not business coverage, ownership, handset, mobile, reachability, DNC/TCPA, or delivery.
iterations.change: Use the NY public register only as a business-contact candidate route, keep generic recipe B held, and require independent owner/direct-contact evidence before any owner-confirmed label.

iterations.test: Focused synthetic regression checks in tests/lead-engine-industry-corrections.test.ts, lead-engine-reviews.test.ts, lead-engine-gates-jobs.test.ts and lead-engine-jobs.test.ts. No paid provider call.
iterations.observed: The never-Maps delivery/quote guard now covers attorney_ny as well as attorney. Export status no longer represents a recipe-B public register number as traced to a home or owner-confirmed.
iterations.change: Shared runtime correction integrated. Original source samples are retained with their original denominators; no phone-yield improvement is claimed.

measurement.result: Five local NY attorney fixture rows were retained as current registrations with a firm and normalized published office phone; the focused parser test passed. Fixture/code audit only; no live source, personal contact, verification, ownership, compliance, or delivery measurement.

cost.basis: Local five-row fixture/code audit only; no source fetch, provider, append, trace, review, or phone-verification call ran.
cost.note: No clean owner contact was measured. Historical brain benchmarks use a different denominator and do not establish clean-contact cost.

implementation.summary: The never-Maps delivery/quote guard now covers attorney_ny as well as attorney. Export status no longer represents a recipe-B public register number as traced to a home or owner-confirmed. Original review: The generic attorney path is a blocked private recipe-B route, while NY has an implemented public registration adapter and a Maps-delivery prohibition. The runtime still delivers a register-derived mobile after generic gates without a supported owner/direct-contact assessment, so owner-confirmed attorney delivery is not implemented.

nextMeasurement: After an owner-evidence gate is wired, run a lawful 5–20 row aggregate test only from the catalog-verified NY public registration endpoint. Keep denominators separate for current registrations, named/solo firm candidates, unique published business phones, matched businesses, independent-owner-supported, mobile, reachable, DNC/TCPA-clear, suppression/duplicate-clear, direct-business-contact-supported, and delivered rows. Do not use residential/property sources to find personal phones; perCleanUsd remains null until an approved outcome study.
